description: The Institute of Chartered Accounting of Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995, Amendments to LKAS 37 - Provisions Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets
reasoning: This gazette content publishes amendments to the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, specifically adopting changes to LKAS 37 (Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets). It involves regulatory standards, legal compliance requirements for financial reporting, and statutory instruments issued under established legislation, making it a clear example of Legal/Regulatory classification.
